sample_unit: nursing handover documents (per-patient NIS log entries)
unlisted_practices: Constraining prompts with section-specific prompt-based interfaces to limit hallucination
Embedding LLM drafting into an existing nursing information system without altering workflows
Using NIS log data to quantify documentation time savings and net labor value

screen.reason: Evaluates the real deployment of an LLM-assisted nursing handover documentation system across three hospitals, measuring pre-post documentation times, but does not compare outcomes with and without a specific safeguard or deployment practice.
